unitTitle: Culture Clips 1 - Routes to Central Europe
scanNote:
Culture Clips bo'limining 1-mavzusi: 'Routes to Central Europe' (Markaziy Yevropaga yo'llar). Bosilgan bet raqami: 154.

⚠ Photo File varaqlarida bet raqami yo'q edi; Culture Clips'da yana raqamlash tiklangan va u 154 dan boshlanadi.

Betda:
• Sarlavha: '1 Routes to Central Europe'
• O'ng yuqorida kirish matni
• 'Pre-reading Activity' — 1-mashq (T/F)
• 'Reading' — 2a mashq (Right / Wrong / Doesn't Say jadvali, 6 ta gap) va 2b (ta'kidlangan so'zlarga zid ma'noli so'z topish)
• Ikkita rangli surat: P&O parom kemasi ('PRIDE OF DOVER') va 'Stena Line LYNX' katamarani
• Bitta matn — Dover haqida

⚠⚠ MUHIM: 2a mashqidagi 6 ta gapning hammasiga BU BETDAN javob topib bo'lmaydi. 3, 4 va 5-gaplar uchun 155-betdagi IKKINChI matn (Channel Tunnel) va faktlar qutisi kerak. Ya'ni mashq IKKI BETGA yoyilgan.

⚠ Xuddi shunday, 2b dagi 5 ta zid so'zdan faqat 3 tasi bu betda ta'kidlangan (short, traditional, same); qolgan 2 tasi (quicker, exciting) 155-betda.

⚠ HALOL IZOH: sarlavhada 'Central Europe' (Markaziy Yevropa) deyilgan, lekin matn va xaritada faqat FRANSIYA va BELGIYA ko'rsatilgan — bular G'arbiy Yevropa mamlakatlari. Britaniyaliklar nuqtai nazaridan 'materik Yevropa' ma'nosida ishlatilgan.

⚠ HALOL IZOH: 'Seacat' — Sea Containers kompaniyasining katamaran-paromlari markasi edi. Dover-Kale yo'nalishidagi bu xizmatlar 2000-yillarning o'rtalarida to'xtatilgan. Kitobdagi ma'lumot yozilgan davr uchun to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: You don't have to fly to get from Britain to central Europe. Why not cross the English Channel by boat, or go through the Channel Tunnel?
exercises.instructionUz: Britaniyadan materik Yevropaga borish uchun samolyotda uchish shart emas. La-Mansh bo'g'ozidan kema bilan o'tsangiz-chi yoki tunnel orqali borsangiz-chi?
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — 'CULTURE CLIPS' BO'LIMINING
BIRINChI MAVZUSI.

  Mavzu: Britaniyadan materik Yevropaga
  qanday borish mumkin.


⚠ BET RAQAMI TIKLANDI:

  Photo File varaqlarida bet raqami yo'q
  edi (ular qirqib olinadigan varaqlar).

  Culture Clips'da raqamlash yana
  boshlanadi — 154-betdan.


KIRISh MATNI:

  'You don't have to fly to get from
   Britain to central Europe. Why not
   cross the English Channel by boat,
   or go through the Channel Tunnel?'


⚠⚠ 'DON'T HAVE TO' — MUHIM QOLIP:

  'You DON'T HAVE TO fly.'
     = Uchish ShART EMAS.
       (Uchsangiz ham bo'ladi, lekin
        majburiy emas.)

  ⚠⚠ 'MUSTN'T' BILAN ADAShTIRMANG!

     'You don't have to fly.'
        = uchish ShART EMAS (erkinlik)

     'You mustn't fly.'
        = uchish TAQIQLANADI (taqiq)

  ⚠ Bu — ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p xato
  qilinadigan juftliklardan biri.


⚠ 'WHY NOT ...?' — TAKLIF:

  'WHY NOT cross the Channel by boat?'
     = Bo'g'ozdan kema bilan o'tsangiz-chi?

  ⚠ 'Why not' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda, 'you' YO'Q:
     'Why not GO?'      ✓
     'Why not you go?'  ✗
     'Why not to go?'   ✗

  ⚠ 144-betdagi 'Why DON'T YOU go?' bilan
  ma'nosi bir xil, lekin qurilishi boshqa:
     'Why don't you GO?'  ('you' BOR)
     'Why not GO?'        ('you' YO'Q)


⚠ 'THE ENGLISH CHANNEL':

  = La-Mansh bo'g'ozi
  (Angliya bilan Fransiya orasidagi
   dengiz bo'g'ozi)

  ⚠ 'a channel' = bo'g'oz; kanal;
     telekanal

  ⚠ Fransuzlar uni 'La Manche' deydi.

  ⚠ 'the Channel Tunnel' = bo'g'oz osti
  tunneli. Xalq orasida 'the Chunnel'
  ('Channel' + 'tunnel') deb ham ataladi.


⚠ 'BY BOAT' — ARTIKLSIZ:

     by boat, by car, by train,
     by plane, by bus

  ⚠ Transport vositasi 'BY' bilan kelsa
  ARTIKL QO'YILMAYDI:
     'by boat'     ✓
     'by the boat' ✗

  ⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON FOOT' (piyoda) —
  'by foot' EMAS!


⚠ HALOL IZOH — SARLAVHA HAQIDA:

  Sarlavhada 'CENTRAL Europe'
  (Markaziy Yevropa) deyilgan.

  Lekin matn va xaritada faqat FRANSIYA
  va BELGIYA ko'rsatilgan — bular
  G'ARBIY Yevropa mamlakatlari.

  Britaniyaliklar 'materik Yevropa'
  ma'nosida ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a route      = yo'l, marshrut
  the English Channel = La-Mansh bo'g'ozi
  the Channel Tunnel = bo'g'oz osti tunneli
  to cross     = kesib o'tmoq
  to fly       = uchmoq
  a boat       = qayiq, kema
  don't have to = shart emas

points.en: You don't have to fly to get from Britain to central Europe.
points.uz: Britaniyadan materik Yevropaga borish uchun samolyotda uchish shart emas.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'DON'T HAVE TO' = ShART EMAS.

ADASHTIRMANG:
  'don't have to fly' = uchish shart emas
  'MUSTN'T fly'       = uchish TAQIQLANADI

Birinchisi — erkinlik, ikkinchisi — taqiq.

points.en: Why not cross the English Channel by boat?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'WHY NOT' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda,
'you' QO'YILMAYDI:
  'Why not cross?'      ✓
  'Why not you cross?'  ✗

⚠ 144-betdagi 'Why don't you...?' bilan
ma'nosi bir xil, qurilishi boshqa.

points.en: ... or go through the Channel Tunnel?
points.noteUz:
'the Channel Tunnel' = bo'g'oz osti tunneli.

⚠ Xalq orasida 'the Chunnel' deb ataladi
('Channel' + 'tunnel').

'through' = ichidan o'tib;
'across' = ustidan/narigi tomonga.

points.en: by boat, by car, by train  —  BUT: on foot
points.uz: kema bilan, mashinada, poyezdda — LEKIN: piyoda
points.noteUz:
⚠ Transport 'BY' bilan kelsa ARTIKL YO'Q:
  'by boat'     ✓
  'by the boat' ✗

⚠⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON foot' (piyoda) —
'by foot' EMAS!

exercises.instructionEn: 1  Pre-reading Activity. Look at the pictures and the map. Which of the following are true statements? Write T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: 1  O'qishdan oldingi mashq. Rasmlarga va xaritaga qarang. Quyidagilardan qaysilari to'g'ri? T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ BU — 'PRE-READING ACTIVITY'
(o'qishdan OLDINGI mashq).

  Maqsadi: matnni o'qishdan oldin
  RASMLAR va XARITAGA qarab taxmin
  qilish.

  ⚠ Xarita 155-betda.


⚠ NEGA 'PRE-READING' KERAK:

  Matnni o'qishdan oldin mavzu bilan
  tanishsangiz, o'qish OSONROQ bo'ladi —
  miya nimani kutishni biladi.


⚠ 'T' va 'F':

     T = TRUE  = to'g'ri
     F = FALSE = noto'g'ri


JAVOBLAR:

  1  F  — Dover ANGLIYADA
           (matnda: 'Dover, on the south
            coast of England')
  2  T  — Folkestone Angliyaning
           janubida (xaritada)
  3  T  — tunnel dengiz TUBI OSTIDAN
           o'tadi (155-bet: '40 metres
           below the seabed')


⚠ 'PRE-' QO'ShIMChASI:

     pre + reading  = o'qishdan OLDIN
     pre + view     = oldindan ko'rish
     pre + pare     = tayyorlamoq

  ⚠ 'pre-' = OLDIN
  ⚠ 'post-' = KEYIN (post-reading)

items.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (F).

Matnda aniq yozilgan:
'Dover, on the south COAST OF ENGLAND'
= Dover Angliyaning janubiy sohilida.

⚠ Belgiyadagi portlar — Ostend va
Zeebrugge (xaritada ko'rinadi).

items.textEn: 2  Folkestone is in the south of England.
items.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (T).

155-betdagi xaritada Folkestone Dover
yonida, Angliyaning janubiy sohilida
turibdi.

⚠ Channel Tunnel aynan Folkestone'dan
boshlanadi.

items.textEn: 3  The Channel Tunnel goes under the seabed.
items.uz: Bo'g'oz osti tunneli dengiz tubi ostidan o'tadi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (T).

155-betdagi matnda:
'The Channel Tunnel is 50 km long and
40 METRES BELOW THE SEABED.'

'the seabed' = dengiz tubi
('sea' + 'bed' — 'dengiz to'shagi').

exercises.instructionEn: 2  a) Read the texts and tick (✓) the correct box for the statements 1-6: Right / Wrong / Doesn't Say. Then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  a) Matnlarni o'qing va 1-6 gaplar uchun to'g'ri katakchani belgilang: To'g'ri / Noto'g'ri / Aytilmagan. So'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠⚠ MASHQ IKKI BETGA YOYILGAN:

  1, 2 va 6-gaplar → 154-betdagi
     DOVER matnidan
  3, 4 va 5-gaplar → 155-betdagi
     TUNNEL matni va FAKTLAR QUTISIDAN

  ⚠ Shuning uchun avval IKKALA matnni
  ham o'qing.


⚠⚠ UCH XIL JAVOB — ENG MUHIM MAHORAT:

  RIGHT (to'g'ri)
     Matnda shunday deyilgan.

  WRONG (noto'g'ri)
     Matnda BOShQAChA deyilgan —
     matn gapga QARShI chiqadi.

  DOESN'T SAY (aytilmagan)
     Matnda bu haqda UMUMAN gap yo'q.
     Rost bo'lishi ham, yolg'on bo'lishi
     ham mumkin — LEKIN MATN AYTMAGAN.

  ⚠⚠ ENG KO'P XATO: 'Doesn't Say' o'rniga
  'Wrong' belgilash.

  ⚠ QOIDA: matnda dalil YO'Q bo'lsa —
  'Doesn't Say'. O'zingiz bilgan narsa
  hisobga OLINMAYDI!


DOVER HAQIDAGI MATN (154-bet):

  'Dover, on the south coast of England,
   is one of the world's busiest PORTS.
   Every day lots of FERRIES and
   high-speed catamarans called "Seacats"
   arrive and leave. It's a SHORT trip
   across the English Channel to Calais
   and Dunkirk in France, or to Ostend
   and Zeebrugge in Belgium. A
   TRADITIONAL ferry takes 90 minutes
   from Dover to Calais, but a catamaran
   is much faster and can make the SAME
   journey in 35 minutes.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Angliyaning janubiy sohilidagi Dover —
   dunyodagi eng band portlardan biri. Har
   kuni ko'plab paromlar va "Seacat" deb
   ataladigan tezyurar katamaranlar kelib-
   ketadi. La-Mansh bo'g'ozi orqali
   Fransiyaning Kale va Dyunkerk shaharlariga
   yoki Belgiyaning Ostend va Zeebrugge
   shaharlariga qisqa sayohat. An'anaviy
   parom Doverdan Kalega 90 daqiqada boradi,
   lekin katamaran ancha tezroq va xuddi shu
   yo'lni 35 daqiqada bosib o'tadi.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  WRONG        (parom 90 daqiqa)
  2  RIGHT        (Seacat — katamaran)
  3  WRONG        (50 km UZUN, 40 metr
                   chuqur)
  4  DOESN'T SAY  (qaysi usul eng ommabop
                   ekani aytilmagan)
  5  WRONG        (1994-yilda ochilgan)
  6  RIGHT        (Ostend — Belgiyada)


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (2a ning ikkinchi
  qismi):

  154-betda:
     Tunnel   = tunnel
     ports    = portlar
     ferries  = paromlar

  155-betda:
     seabed      = dengiz tubi
     expensive   = qimmat
     sightseeing = diqqatga sazovor
                   joylarni tomosha qilish

items.textEn: 1  It takes 35 minutes to travel from Dover to Calais by ferry.
items.uz: Doverdan Kalega parom bilan borish 35 daqiqa vaqt oladi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (Wrong).

Matnda:
'A traditional FERRY takes 90 MINUTES
from Dover to Calais, but a CATAMARAN
... in 35 MINUTES.'

⚠ TUZOQ: 35 daqiqa raqami matnda BOR,
lekin u KATAMARAN uchun, parom uchun emas!

⚠ Bunday tuzoqqa e'tibor bering: raqam
to'g'ri, lekin BOSHQA narsaga tegishli.

items.textEn: 2  A Seacat is a high-speed catamaran.
items.whyUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI (Right).

Matnda:
'high-speed catamarans CALLED "Seacats"'
= 'Seacat' deb ataladigan tezyurar
katamaranlar.

⚠ 'called' = deb ataladigan — nom berish
uchun ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: 3  The Channel Tunnel is 50km below the seabed.
items.uz: Bo'g'oz osti tunneli dengiz tubidan 50 km pastda.
items.whyUz:
⚠ NOTO'G'RI (Wrong). Javob 155-betdagi
matnda:

'The Channel Tunnel is 50 KM LONG and
40 METRES BELOW the seabed.'

⚠ TUZOQ: 50 km — UZUNLIGI, chuqurligi
emas! Chuqurligi — 40 METR.

⚠ Ikki o'lchov ATAYLAB almashtirilgan.

items.textEn: 4  The most popular way to cross the Channel is by Seacat.
items.uz: Bo'g'ozdan o'tishning eng ommabop usuli — Seacat.
items.whyUz:
⚠⚠ AYTILMAGAN (Doesn't Say) — bu betdagi
ENG QIYIN band!

Ikkala matnda ham Seacat, parom va tunnel
TASVIRLANGAN, lekin QAYSI BIRI ENG OMMABOP
ekani HECH QAYERDA aytilmagan.

⚠ 'Wrong' deb belgilash — XATO. 'Wrong'
faqat matn gapga QARSHI chiqqanda
qo'yiladi.

⚠ QOIDA: matnda dalil yo'q → 'Doesn't Say'.

⚠ NOTO'G'RI (Wrong). Javob 155-betdagi
FAKTLAR QUTISIDA:

'Since it opened in 1994, 57 million
people ... have travelled through the
Channel Tunnel.'

⚠ 1994-yil, 1995 emas.

⚠ E'TIBOR: javob asosiy matnda emas,
KICHIK QUTIDA yashiringan. Bunday
qutilarni ham o'qish kerak!

⚠ TO'G'RI (Right).

Matnda:
'... or to OSTEND and Zeebrugge in
BELGIUM.'

⚠ 155-betdagi xaritada ham Ostend
Belgiya hududida ko'rsatilgan —
ikki manbadan tasdiqlanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: 2  b) Match the highlighted words to their opposites in the list: boring, long, different, modern, slower.
exercises.instructionUz: 2  b) Ta'kidlangan so'zlarni ro'yxatdagi zid ma'noli so'zlar bilan moslang: boring, long, different, modern, slower.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ TA'KIDLANGAN (ko'k rangda) SO'ZLAR
IKKI BETGA TARQALGAN:

  154-betda: short, traditional, same
  155-betda: quicker, exciting

  Ro'yxatda ham AYNAN 5 ta so'z bor —
  demak har biriga bittadan juft.


⚠ ZID MA'NOLI SO'Z = 'AN OPPOSITE'
  (yoki 'an antonym')


BARCHA JUFTLAR:

  short       ↔  long        (qisqa/uzun)
  traditional ↔  modern      (an'anaviy/
                              zamonaviy)
  same        ↔  different   (bir xil/
                              boshqa)
  quicker     ↔  slower      (tezroq/
                              sekinroq)
  exciting    ↔  boring      (qiziqarli/
                              zerikarli)


⚠ IKKI JUFT — QIYOSIY DARAJADA:

     'quicker' va 'slower'

  Ikkalasi ham '-ER' bilan tugaydi —
  QIYOSIY DARAJA (taqqoslash).

  ⚠ Shuning uchun javob ham '-er' bilan
  bo'lishi kerak:
     quicker ↔ slowER  ✓
     quicker ↔ slow    ✗


⚠ ZID MA'NO YASASHNING IKKI YO'LI:

  1) BUTUNLAY BOShQA SO'Z:
     short ↔ long
     same  ↔ different

  2) INKOR QO'ShIMChASI:
     possible  ↔ IMpossible
     happy     ↔ UNhappy
     polite    ↔ IMpolite
     correct   ↔ INcorrect

  ⚠ Bu betdagi barcha juftlar 1-turdan.

pairs.whyUz:
Matnda: 'It's a SHORT trip across the
English Channel.'

⚠ 'short' ikki ma'noda: qisqa (vaqt/masofa)
va past bo'yli (odam haqida).

Bu yerda — VAQT/MASOFA haqida.

Matnda: 'A TRADITIONAL ferry takes 90
minutes.'

⚠ Matn an'anaviy paromni zamonaviy
katamaran bilan taqqoslayapti.

'a tradition' (ot) → 'traditional' (sifat).

Matnda: '... can make the SAME journey
in 35 minutes.'

⚠ 'the same' HAR DOIM 'the' bilan keladi:
  'the same journey'  ✓
  'a same journey'    ✗

⚠ 'the same AS' — taqqoslashda:
'My bag is the same AS yours.'

155-betdagi matnda: 'It's more expensive
than a ferry, but QUICKER.'

⚠⚠ IKKALASI HAM QIYOSIY DARAJADA ('-er'):
  quicker ↔ slowER  ✓
  quicker ↔ slow    ✗

⚠ 'quick' va 'fast' ma'nodosh, lekin
'fast' ko'proq harakat tezligi haqida.

155-betdagi matnda: '... but quicker and
much more EXCITING.'

⚠ Ikkalasi ham '-ING' bilan tugaydi —
NARSA qanaqaligini bildiradi:
  'The film is boring.' (film zerikarli)

⚠ '-ED' shakli ODAMNING his-tuyg'usi:
  'I am bored.' (men zerikdim)

⚠ ENG KO'P XATO: 'I am boring' =
'men zerikarli odamman'!

patterns.exampleEn: You don't have to fly to get to central Europe.
patterns.exampleUz: Materik Yevropaga borish uchun uchish shart emas.

patterns.exampleEn: Why not cross the Channel by boat?
A traditional ferry takes 90 minutes from Dover to Calais.
patterns.exampleUz: An'anaviy parom Doverdan Kalega 90 daqiqada boradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'It takes + VAQT' — qancha vaqt
ketishini bildiradi.
⚠ Ega 'it' — o'zgarmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: A catamaran is much faster than a ferry.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'MUCH' qiyosiy darajani kuchaytiradi
('very' EMAS!):
  'much faster'  ✓
  'very faster'  ✗
